bear_assumptions: Comparable sales weaken, franchisees retrench, input and labor costs rise, international execution slips and leverage limits capital returns.
base_assumptions: Unit growth and franchise fees support earnings despite modest comparable sales; margins and franchisee health remain stable and leverage is serviced.
bull_assumptions: Comparable sales reaccelerate, unit growth compounds, franchisee returns improve and operating leverage plus disciplined capital returns lift per-share earnings.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after comparable sales, leverage and an accepted relationship clear downside and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if franchisee economics, unit growth, cash flow or debt service deteriorate.
